title: Stoker plugins — plugin
description: `plugins/<key>/plugin.json`: what a plugin is, across its versions. A plugin catalogue is its own format, apart from the game metadata: games name a plugin only by key and version, so the catalogue can sit beside the games or in a repository of its own with the same layout. The files are never in the catalogue — each version lists its files by hash and where their author publishes them — and a Stoker host runs no version its administrator has not approved.

key.description: The folder's name, and the key every version's manifest declares.

license.description: An SPDX licence expression — `MIT`, `LGPL-2.1-only`, `CC-BY-NC-ND-4.0` — or `LicenseRef-<name>` for one SPDX does not list. What a host may do with the files is the licence's answer, which is why the catalogue links to the author's copy rather than keeping one.

kind.description: `hook`: native code a Stoker bootstrap loads inside a game; assigned to games and releases. `mod`: files an install lays into a game for a mod loader — the loader itself (BepInEx), or a plugin for it; assigned like a hook. `unpacker`: a .NET assembly in Steamless's plugin format that removes a store's DRM wrapper from a stored build — it runs on the Stoker host itself, never in a game, is named only by a build's `unpack` step, and needs its administrator's approval every time a new version is to run. `library`: a file other plugins load (`Steamless.API`), never assigned and never run on its own.
